memory.content: Uses bunx faf-cli for project.faf facts and the CLI score line. Does not invent slots, scores, tiers, goals, or 6 Ws.

If a clone already contains project.faf, score that file with bunx faf-cli score. Do not run faf git or faf auto, and do not overwrite. Only run faf git / faf auto when there is no project.faf in the repo.
Trophy tier border/accent color is gold, not orange.

Speed: Reuse the clone if /workspace already has that repo. Do not clone twice. If project.faf exists: only bunx faf-cli score — no auto, no git, no install. Pin faf-cli once (bunx is fine after the first hit; don't re-download for every card). Render PNGs without a full browser if possible (svg→png, or screenshot one html file for both faces). No extra searches, no extra reads, no status essays while working. First message back is the score line, then the three paths.
Footer on both card faces is exactly: repo-slug · filled/active · Tier (e.g. owner/repo · 9/9 · Trophy). No © TROPHY mark.
